We understand that while work is just one aspect of who we are, a truly inclusive culture accounts for the full authenticity of every single human being that works here.

About The Opportunity

At Salsify, our Product team fosters an environment of growth, curiosity, collaboration, and deep empathy for our users and each other. As a Product Manager 2 on our Network Core team, you will be the steward of our foundational global Network of critical integrations with global retail and ecommerce platform partners. This role is critical as we work to make informed decisions that allow Salsify to continue our leadership in the PXM category by enabling our customers and partners to provide consumers with a best-in-class omnichannel experience.

In this role, we’re looking for a proactive learner who is excited about understanding technical concepts and connecting those with business value. Our Network Core team is tasked with maintaining, enhancing, and evolving our network of key content destinations like Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and many others, to enable our customers to “make every product experience matter”. A successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to build a functional understanding of our ecosystem, prioritize investments to ensure platform reliability and maintainability, and partner closely with Engineering, cross-functional partners, and Product leadership to bridge the gap between technical requirements, user needs, and business value.

What does success look like?

• Ensure the stability of core foundational systems while identifying incremental improvements and AI-driven enhancements to optimize workflows.
• Develop domain expertise and become a credible resource for both internal teams and external partners -- documenting and sharing learnings to enable the broader organization.
• Navigate complex migrations, deprecations, and technical investment initiatives by providing clear visibility into timelines and risks.
• Operate effectively in partnership with Engineering, other PMs, and Design demonstrating technical aptitude and developing a shared vision.

If You’re The Ideal Candidate

• You possess a high capacity for, and drive to learn technical domains (e.g., system reliability, infrastructure, or technical operations) and can translate that knowledge into well-documented requirements, which are framed appropriately for your engineering team, your leadership team, your cross-functional partners, and of course, your customers.
• You have a proven track record of independently proposing pragmatic solutions and gaining buy-in across R&D teams for horizontal initiatives.
• You leverage data to prioritize the important over the urgent, and you are methodical in addressing both short-term fixes and long-term stability.
• You can adapt your communication style to resonate with everyone from engineers to customers to product leadership, ensuring alignment on objectives and dependencies.
• You bring a positive, growth-oriented mindset to a constantly evolving environment and view setbacks as opportunities to learn.
• You’re able to Identify opportunities to enhance the value of technical investments by finding opportunities to connect them with customer or business facing initiatives that drive more visible value to non-technical stakeholders.

Background And Experience

• 5+ years of product management or similar experience in technical domains, especially focusing on Network or partnership, system reliability, technical operations, or infrastructure projects.
• Proven track record of building strong cross-functional relationships with colleagues and partners and building influence within an organization that is brimming with strong opinions and deep expertise.
• Strong interpersonal skills: must be sharp, energetic, outspoken, and results-oriented; able to prioritize and focus in a constantly evolving environment.
• Problem-solving abilities: You're proactive in identifying issues, and you're methodical in creating solutions that address both short-term fixes and long-term stability.
• Ability to collect and deeply understand user feedback and then amplify that learning to the organization.
• Strong change management skills including sorting through ambiguity and a positive mindset about change
• An analytical mindset and the aptitude to partner with Engineering on more technical projects
• You leverage data to prioritize investments and make informed decisions that maximize impact.
• Experience with escalation management.

There may be up to 5% travel required including international travel for in-person company, departmental, team or customer meetings.

At Salsify, we maintain 3 core principles as part of our Compensation Philosophy:

• We pay market rates, which are competitive and equitable
• We pay based on performance and proficiency, not tenure
• We adjust proactively; when the market moves, we do too

The posted compensation range reflects the base salary for this position. In addition to base salary, some eligible roles may also have a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Salsify employees receive equity in the form of stock options. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, PTO, and more. Offers to join Salsify are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate’s work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.

National Pay Range

€53.125 - €62.500 EUR

Salsify loves a good success story and it would be our privilege to help write yours! We recognize that talent and potential come in all forms and that years of experience does not guarantee on-the-job effectiveness or leadership potential. Our hiring process involves recognizing a person’s achievements, subject matter expertise, and passion, not just check marks next to a job description. If you have an interest in our roles please do not hesitate to apply - we would be happy to speak with you!

A member of Talent 'talent@salsify.com' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.

Salsify’s mission is to empower brand manufacturers to win on the digital shelf.

Helping brand manufacturers to win online is what we do. Our culture is who we are. We are empowered. We are positive thinkers. We take action. We care deeply. These values have driven Salsify’s growth and earned the company numerous top workplace awards.

We are headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts and have hubs in Lisbon (Portugal) and Sydney (Australia). If you are excited to work in a fast-paced environment with a team that values agility, curiosity and passion, we want to hear from you!

As part of the hiring process, we may be conducting reference checks with your provided contacts.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for information on the personal data we process in connection with your application.

An Inclusive Place To Work

Salsify does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Studies have found that people of color and women do not apply to jobs if they do not meet all the requirements. At Salsify we are committed to empowering a diverse workforce. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Accommodations

Salsify is committed to an inclusive hiring process, and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact cx@salsify.com.

We take your security seriously. When applying for a position with us, please be aware of the following:

Official Communication Channels

All legitimate communications from our team, including interview requests and job offers, will only come from an email address ending in @salsify.com. We will never use generic email addresses (like Gmail or Yahoo) or ask you to communicate through unofficial channels.

Verify Job Postings

Always verify the legitimacy of any Salsify job posting by checking our official website's careers page. If a position is not listed there, it is not a genuine Salsify opening.

Secure Application Process

We use secure applicant tracking systems and encrypted communication channels to protect your sensitive information and documents throughout the application process.

No Payments Ever Required

Legitimate employers, including Salsify, will never ask for upfront payments for applications, training, or equipment. Any request for payment is a clear sign of a scam.

Personal Information Requests

Sensitive personal information, such as bank details or social security numbers, will only be requested after a formal job offer has been made and exclusively through secure, verified channels.By being aware of these protocols, you can help us ensure a safe and secure application experience.
